blocks.text: «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.»
«The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in **-ь** is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in **-у** or **-ю**.»
Masculine nouns that decline like feminines
«There are some masculine nouns ending in **-а**, **-я** which are declined like feminine nouns.»
